# Copilot repository guidance

This is a collection of independent DevOps examples, provisioning roles, and OS
configuration notes, not an application with a shared build or test suite.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the repository's editing, safety, and validation
rules. Read the matching `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` files when
working on documentation, PowerShell, or infrastructure examples.

Do not run provisioning or alter the local machine to validate an ordinary edit.
Keep examples free of real credentials and machine-specific personal settings.
Preserve the target platform and legacy compatibility unless migration is part
of the request. Use the nearest actual configuration rather than README template
text as evidence of supported tools and behavior.
